linkedin.title: Most news apps are designed to make you panic.
linkedin.body:
They rely on infinite scrolls and breaking alerts to keep your attention glued to the screen. It works for ad revenue, but it is a terrible way to stay informed. We built Headlinne to do the exact opposite.

Our philosophy is simple. You should control your news, not the other way around. We use AI to cut through the noise, not to amplify it. Instead of showing you everything that is happening, we focus on what actually matters to you. It is about depth over speed.

A calmer experience means you spend less time scrolling and more time understanding the world. We believe that when you strip away the sensationalism, you are left with the facts. That is how you build a habit that feels useful rather than draining.

story_card.headline: Voyager 1 hits a massive distance milestone
story_card.standfirst: The NASA spacecraft is now one light-day away from Earth.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: On November 18, Voyager 1 became the first human object to reach one light-day from Earth.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: This milestone follows decades of travel through deep space by the NASA spacecraft.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: It marks a record-breaking distance for human engineering in our solar system.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Look for NASA archives that show photos from its journey of discovery.

story_card.caption:
NASA Voyager 1 has officially reached a distance of one light-day from Earth.

This historic achievement makes Voyager 1 the first human-made object to travel this far into space. The craft continues to provide us with incredible data and images from the outer reaches of our solar system.
